summary: Serge Rielau proposes a new SQL data type, OBJECT, that matches structured fields by name rather than position, addressing the current limitations of STRUCT. The discussion centers on a proposal to broaden Spark Data Source V2 push-down capabilities to include full outer, semi, and anti joins, alias tolerance, set operations (UNION, INTERSECT, EXCEPT), and window functions. The discussion proposes the first Spark community sync on Nov 30, 2026, at 8:30 AM PST, with a 50‑minute agenda covering recent changes, SPIPs, release status, and an open floor. Huaxin updated the SPIP document to incorporate reviewer feedback, adding detailed security guarantees, a dedicated PolicyEnforcement operator, and stricter handling of writes to protected tables.
